summary: Iter13 testing (both). Backend: added tests/test_iter13_surcharge_delete_flows.py with 9 new tests (all passing). Full backend suite 110/110 passing (up from 101). Covered: (1) RepairPartUsed.surcharge persists on POST + PUT, parts_used_total = Σ(qty*unit_price + surcharge); stock delta correct on update. (2) enrich_refurb parts_cost via ticket collegato: cost 100 + (qty 1 * price 20 + surcharge 7) => total_cost=127, expected_margin=173 with target=300. (3) PUT /repairs/{id} final_price on consegnata+paid updates cash_movements.amount; PUT paid=false rimuove il movimento. (4) DELETE /repairs?restore_parts=false lascia stock invariato; ?restore_parts=true ripristina stock SENZA creare acquisto_ricambi. (5) DELETE /refurbished?delete_sale=true&restore_parts=true elimina refurb+sale+cassa vendita+repair collegata e ripristina stock (no acquisto movements). (6) delete_sale=false mantiene la vendita. (7) sync_refurb_sale_cost aggiorna sale.cost_total e sale.margin quando cambia parts_used del ticket collegato (test: 300-125=175). Frontend Playwright E2E: login OK; row-detail dialogs verificati per tutte e 4 le pagine (customer-detail-dialog + customer-detail-edit, part-detail-dialog, repair-detail-dialog + repair-detail-edit, sale-detail-dialog); repair form: TEST_UI_Zero (qty=0) NON appare in repair-part-select-0 (0 opzioni), TEST_UI_Disp (qty>0) appare, selezionandolo repair-part-price-0 auto-popolato a 20, repair-part-surcharge-0 accetta valore 5. Delete-refurb cascade: 3 confirm sequenziali intercettati e accettati ('Eliminare il dispositivo…', 'eliminare anche la vendita…', 'ripristinarli in magazzino?'); post-delete: refurb 404 ✓, sale scomparsa ✓, stock ripristinato a 3 ✓, nessun nuovo movimento acquisto_ricambi (rispetto al pre-esistente creato dalla POST /parts). Tutti i dati TEST_ ripuliti via API.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:176 parts_used_total correctly sums qty*unit_price + surcharge; used by enrich_refurb line 1293 so total_cost/expected_margin/margin propagate automatically.
server.py:924-927 update_repair handles final_price change AND paid=false (delete_many by reference_id) in the same PUT — clean and idempotent.
server.py:928 sync_refurb_sale_cost invoked after every repair update — ensures sale.cost_total and sale.margin stay in sync with the ticket's parts_used (test: 100 -> 125 -> margin 175 verified).

server.py:949-956 delete_repair with restore_parts:bool=True is the correct default (safer) and IMPORTANTLY does NOT create cash movements (apply_parts_stock_delta only increments parts.quantity — no cash side-effect) — matches the spec 'il ripristino NON crea uscite di cassa'.

server.py:1493-1510 delete_refurbished cascade with delete_sale/restore_parts flags: also cleans cash movements for refurb_costs ids and sale_id — comprehensive. Deletes the linked repair (delete_one) after applying stock delta.

RepairsPage.jsx:459-471 repair-part-surcharge-{i} column present; onChange writes surcharge to the parts_used entry — flows into POST/PUT.
RefurbDetailDialog.jsx:48 Timeline shows part_name ×qty +surcharge € — verified string format matches spec.
DetailDialog.jsx is a clean generic component reused by all 4 pages (customer/part/repair/sale) — good DRY.
